data.description: Today, in Chicago, Professional Diversity Network, Inc. data.title: Qnity Appoints Semiconductor Finance Veteran Ken Rizvi Chief Financial Officer

data.title: Epicor Prism Launches Across Latin America, Bringing Embedded, Industry-Specific AI to Manufacturers and Distributors
data.description: In Austin, Texas, Epicor has strengthened its AI-based ERP approach in the Latin American region by launching Epicor Prism, a series of specialized vertical AI agents tailored for the supply chain sector. Integrated into Epicor Kinetic and Prophet 21 platforms, Epicor Prism allows manufacturers and distributors in the region to interact conversationally with real-time ERP data and associated files, eliminating the necessity for advanced analytics expertise or separate AI applications. This move aims to streamline operations for companies in Latin America and enhance efficiency in handling ERP information.

data.title: S4 Honcho™ Begins U.S. Dealer Deliveries as LiveWire Names Nationwide Giveaway Winner
data.description: Milwaukee-based LiveWire, a leading player in the electric two-wheel sector, has revealed the introduction of the initial batch of S4 Honcho™ Trail motorcycles in the United States. This launch signifies the start of the company's debut mini-moto platform rollout among its U.S. dealers. Jon Bekefy, LiveWire's Head of Commercial, expressed enthusiasm, stating that the arrival of the first S4 Honcho Trail motorcycles in the U.S. is a significant milestone for LiveWire and its dealer network. The company trades under the ticker symbol LVWR on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE).

data.title: Meridian3 Industrials Acquisition Corp Announces the Separate Trading of its Class A Ordinary Shares and Warrants Commencing August 24, 2026
data.description: On August 24, 2026, Meridian3 Industrials Acquisition Corp revealed that holders of the units from its initial public offering of 20,125,000 units (with gross proceeds of $201,250,000) can opt to independently trade the Class A ordinary shares and warrants. The offering encompassed 2,625,000 units due to full underwriter over-allotment option exercise. Those who choose not to separate the units can continue trading on Nasdaq Global Market as "MIACU," while separated Class A ordinary shares and warrants will trade as "MIAC" and "MIACW." No partial warrants will be given upon separation, only whole warrants. To split the units, holders must have their brokers liaise with Continental Stock Transfer & Trust Company, acting as the Company's transfer agent.

data.title: Gladiator Metals Corp. Begins Trading on OTCQX Best Market
data.description: On August 21, 2026, OTC Markets Group Inc. disclosed that Gladiator Metals Corp., a mineral exploration company, has qualified to trade on the OTCQX Best Market. OTC Markets Group Inc. is known for operating regulated markets for trading a total of 12,000 U.S. and international securities. Gladiator Metals Corp. upgraded to the OTCQX from the OTCQB Venture Market. It should be noted that Gladiator Metals Corp. trades under the tickers TSX-V: GLAD and OTCQX: GDTRF.

data.title: Christina Lake Cannabis Announces Non-Binding Letter of Intent
data.description: Christina Lake has entered into a non-binding Letter of Intent (LOI) for a potential acquisition of all its shares. The proposed deal is valued at $15 million and is contingent on various conditions such as due diligence, repayment of debt, and the finalization of a definitive agreement.

data.description: PharmAla Biotech issued a corporate update regarding its collaboration with investment banking firm Canaccord Genuity LLC and its intellectual property (IP). The announcement highlights key developments in the partnership and IP strategy of the company.

data.title: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court Issues Favorable Decision for Brazil Potash
data.description: In Manaus, Brazil, on Aug. 21, 2026, Brazil Potash Corp. (NYSE American: GRO), a mineral exploration company focusing on potash agriculture, shared that the Autazes Potash Project has received continued support. Following a previous announcement from July 16, 2026, Brazil's Supreme Federal Court (STF) dismissed a petition aiming to stop construction permits and project development. The Autazes Project, crucial for potash production, remains unaffected by the court's decision.

data.title: Bunker Hill and Silver47 Announce Merger to Create a ‘Made in America’ U.S. Silver & Critical Minerals Champion
data.description: Kellogg, Idaho and Vancouver, British Columbia - On August 21, 2026, Bunker Hill Mining Corp. ("Bunker Hill") (TSX: BNKR | OTCQB: BHLL) and Silver47 Exploration Corp. ("Silver47") (TSXV: AGA | OTCQX: AAGAF | Frankfurt: QP2) announced a definitive arrangement agreement dated August 20, 2026. Under this agreement, Bunker Hill will acquire all outstanding common shares of Silver47 through a plan of arrangement. The combined entity, to be named "Bunker Hill Silver Corp.," will continue trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange.

data.title: McChip Announces Board Changes
data.description: On August 21, 2026, McChip Resources Inc. (TSXV: MCS) disclosed the appointment of Mr. Fraser Hartley as an independent Director of the Company. This announcement marks a strategic decision by McChip to enhance its leadership team.

data.title: Synaptics Announces Chief Financial Officer Transition
data.description: On August 21, 2026, in San Jose, California, Synaptics® Incorporated (Nasdaq: SYNA) disclosed that Ken Rizvi has stepped down from his role as Chief Financial Officer. This change is effective immediately as Rizvi is moving to explore a different career opportunity. Despite his resignation, Mr. Rizvi will continue to serve in an advisory capacity until September 30, 2026, aiding in the smooth transition of his duties within the company.
